Lina (support): heads up — Velora completed SSO onboarding but their API key isn't visible in the console. Their app gets 403 on /v1/keys with "not bound to project" message. Can someone check?
Maya (CS): I can repro the customer flow. Provisioner emitted a KEY_CREATED event at 3170015520 but console shows "unlinked". Ticket VL-102.
Provisioner Bot: Provisioner event: claim_id=clm-9f2a status=FAILED reason=org_policy:restrict-service-bind
Jake (eng-infra): @Lina (support) can you paste the provisioning request id + raw provisioner response? also which org/project (velora-prod)?
Lina (support): req id: req-0a1b2c
Raw response snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "serviceAccountBindingForbidden",
  "reason": "org policy 'restrict-service-binding' prevents binding SA to project velora-prod",
  "request_id": "req-0a1b2c",
  "claim_id": "clm-9f2a"
}
```
Ricardo (platform): looks like the org policy blocked the service account binding. Provisioner created the key in the management project but couldn't attach it to velora-prod. Manual path: create SA in velora-prod and bind roles, or re-run a reconcile that creates+binds from a privileged runner. I can take it unless you want to hand off.
Maya (CS): please go ahead — customer is blocked in prod. tagging maintenance window @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance window in ~10m for infra change. Pager assigned: Jake (eng-infra).
Ricardo (platform): running reconcile now — command I used:
```
rwdctl reconcile bind --org velora-prod --sa velora-provisioner-sa --request req-0a1b2c
```
Provisioner Bot: reconcile: started for req-0a1b2c
Provisioner Bot: reconcile: bind: success key_id=k_zz123 visible_in_console=true
Lina (support): verified with Velora — key is now listed in console and their app gets 200 on /v1/keys. Customer confirmed. Closing ticket. :tada:
Maya (CS): can we add a clearer failure surface when org policies block binds? current message is opaque for CS.
Ricardo (platform): agreed — i'll open INF-4512 to surface org-policy mismatch early in the UI and make provisioner fail-fast with actionable text.
Maya (CS): thanks team!
